name: digitalReferenceMaterialDocument
description: The structural root of the DRMD configuration. Supports both Reference Material Certificate (CRM) and Product Information Sheet (RM) document profiles. Systematically coordinates core metadata, physical product catalogs, measurement results, and cryptographic blocks into six interconnected electronic containers, maintaining data integrity for global laboratory data exchanges. The document profile is determined by the titleOfTheDocument element in coreData; profile-specific constraints are enforced via companion Schematron rules (drmd-business-rules.sch) per ISO 33401:2024, Table 1.

attributes.name: schemaVersion
attributes.description: Specifies the semantic version string (major.minor.patch) of the DRMD schema specification (e.g., "0.3.0"). Major version updates signify breaking structural transformations requiring parser schema migration paths. Minor version updates indicate backward-compatible additions of optional elements or identifier schemes. Patch versions address non-structural schema documentation corrections or minor text clarifications.

children.name: administrativeData
children.description: A required container grouping non-technical document metadata, organizational producer profiles, and authorized signatory frameworks required to establish certificate authenticity.

rules.description: [DRMD-001] Every DRMD document MUST declare a titleOfTheDocument in coreData, specifying either 'referenceMaterialCertificate' or 'productInformationSheet'.

[RMC-010] Reference Material Certificates MUST list responsible persons including the name and function of the RM producer's approving officer (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.5 — Name and function of the RM producer's approving officer: 'Mandatory' for RM certificate, 'Optional' for product information sheet).

children.name: coreData
children.description: Primary administrative metadata column holding the identity credentials of the electronic document, specifying its type level, globally unique structural fingerprint, external cross-reference indexes, and legal lifespan bounds.

rules.description: [DRMD-001] Every DRMD document MUST declare a titleOfTheDocument in coreData, specifying either 'referenceMaterialCertificate' or 'productInformationSheet'.

children.name: titleOfTheDocument
children.description: A mandatory metrological classification defining the regulatory and quality assurance tier of the document. - referenceMaterialCertificate: Identifies a Certified Reference Material (CRM) per ISO 33401:2024. The document MUST contain at least one property value with an associated measurement uncertainty and a metrological traceability statement. Instructs downstream data systems that properties carry certified values suitable for calibration purposes. - productInformationSheet: Identifies a Reference Material (RM) per ISO 33401:2024. Property values are valid measurement results but are not required to include measurement uncertainty or metrological traceability. The distinction from a certificate is solely that no value is certified with uncertainty and traceability.

rules.description: [DRMD-001] Every DRMD document MUST declare a titleOfTheDocument in coreData, specifying either 'referenceMaterialCertificate' or 'productInformationSheet'.

children.name: uniqueIdentifier
children.description: A mandatory unique string token (preferring standard UUID formats) serving as the document's unalterable digital fingerprint. Prevents identifier collisions in distributed storage architectures; any post-issuance data modifications force the generation of a completely unique identifier tracking asset.

children.name: documentVersion
children.description: A mandatory version string identifying the revision of this document. Enables tracking of document updates and ensures recipients can verify they hold the current version (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.13).

children.name: documentIdentifiers
children.description: An optional linkage folder combining multiple external system identities (such as persistent publishing DOIs or business ERP numbers) to ensure automated tracking across global databases.

children.name: documentIdentifier
children.description: A unified core building block pattern for strong machine identifiers. Pairs a mandatory authority classification scheme with a clean tracking string token value. Includes an optional direct URL link for online source verification and attributes supporting native XML relational mappings (@id, @refId, @refType).

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: A unique XML ID attribute for cross-referencing this element within the document.

attributes.name: refId
attributes.description: One or more IDREF values pointing to other elements in the document for cross-referencing.

attributes.name: refType
attributes.description: Controlled vocabulary enumerations that classify internal XML cross-referencing relationships. Restricts the scope of relation attributes to ensure uniform machine interpretation of linked element semantics. - basic_certificateIdentification: Maps an operational identity token specifically to a document metadata anchor. - basic_measuredValue: Validates and assigns measurement payload segments explicitly as structured quantity records.

children.name: scheme
children.description: Defines the specific naming system, database authority, or registry standard being utilized (e.g., 'DOI', 'CAS', 'ROR'). Instructs parsing systems on how to route lookups and interpret the companion token string.

children.name: value
children.description: The exact alphanumeric identifier string or key code generated by the authority. Must remain clear of descriptive textual commentary to preserve indexing usability during search and database lookups.

children.name: link
children.description: An optional, persistent canonical landing page URI or direct URL (preferably secure HTTPS) enabling software consumers to immediately execute real-time origin lookup validation.

children.name: validity
children.description: A mandatory choice configuration establishing the legal and physical lifespan of the certificate. Enforces strict quality control to mitigate safety risks or measurement failures stemming from aged, degraded materials. Instruments match this data block against real-time evaluation dates to automatically lock out expired materials.

rules.description: [DRMD-012] Every DRMD document MUST specify a validity period or condition (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.8 — Period of validity).

children.name: untilRevoked
children.description: Indicates permanent validity for inherently stable materials that do not exhibit time-based degradation. The dataset remains continuously active until an explicit update or revocation notice is issued by the producer.

children.name: timeAfterDispatch
children.description: Defines relative validity for substances whose operational shelf-life is triggered upon shipment. Laboratory information management systems parse this period to calculate a specific expiration cutoff for individual units.

children.name: dispatchDate
children.description: The optional calendar date of physical shipment. Under strict governance frameworks, this may be bound to the cryptographic timestamp of the document signing event that constitutes formal legal issuance.

children.name: period
children.description: A mandatory ISO 8601 duration format string (e.g., 'P3Y2M') stating the exact lifespan span allotted for material use once dispatched.

children.name: specificTime
children.description: Imposes a fixed expiration cutoff date utilizing the standard YYYY-MM-DD configuration. Represents a hard stop threshold for safety and compliance, past which the material must not be used for calibration or quality control.

children.name: referenceMaterialProducer
children.description: Authoritative block describing the organization legally and operationally accountable for the reference material and documentation. Maps human-friendly multilingual names, structured contact points, cryptographic policy declarations, and stable ROR indexes.

rules.description: [DRMD-010] Every DRMD document MUST identify the referenceMaterialProducer (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.5 — Name and contact details of the RM producer).

children.name: name
children.description: The official, long-form multilingual name of the producer organization. For international interoperability, producers provide multiple ISO-639-1 language variants (e.g., 'en', 'de') to support localized rendering.

For productInformationSheet documents, this element is optional.

children.description: The definition of complex quantities in the D-SI metadata model. The following statements of a complex quantity are possible. [(m)-mandatory, (o)-optional] 1. Basic measured quantity in Cartesian form (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element valueReal (decimal value type) (m) - element valueImag (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) 2. Basic measured quantity in polar form (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element valueMagnitude (decimal value type) (m) - element valuePhase (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (m) - element unitPhase (string - SI unit for an angular quantity) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) 3. Basic measured quantity in Cartesian form with bivariate uncertainty (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element valueReal (decimal value type) (m) - element valueImag (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (m) - choice si:ellipsoidalRegion or si:rectangularRegion for the bivariate uncertainty 4. Basic measured quantity in polar form with bivariate uncertainty (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element valueMagnitude (decimal value type) (m) - element valuePhase (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (m) - element unitPhase (string - SI unit for an angular quantity) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (m) - choice si:ellipsoidalRegion or si:rectangularRegion for the bivariate uncertainty

children.name: constant
children.description: Definition of a structure for real numbers, that represent for fundamental physical constants and mathematical constants. The element has the following components [(m)-mandatory, (o)-optional]: (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element value (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (o) - element significantDigit (integer) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (o) - element valueStandardMU (decimal value >= 0) (o) - element distribution (string) The value and the uncertainty have the unit specified by the element unit. For fundamental physical constants, that are defined experimentally, the uncertainty is the standard deviation. For rounded mathematical constants, the uncertainty is the standard deviation of a rectangular distribution (element value defines center point), that contains the exact value of the constant with 100 percent probability.

children.name: constant
children.description: Definition of a structure for real numbers, that represent for fundamental physical constants and mathematical constants. The element has the following components [(m)-mandatory, (o)-optional]: (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element value (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (o) - element significantDigit (integer) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (o) - element valueStandardMU (decimal value >= 0) (o) - element distribution (string) The value and the uncertainty have the unit specified by the element unit. For fundamental physical constants, that are defined experimentally, the uncertainty is the standard deviation. For rounded mathematical constants, the uncertainty is the standard deviation of a rectangular distribution (element value defines center point), that contains the exact value of the constant with 100 percent probability.

children.description: The core metrological repository structuring certified and informational measurement data tables, uncertainties, D-SI units, and substance mapping keys.

rules.description: [DRMD-003] Every DRMD document MUST contain at least one properties block with measurement data (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.15 — Property of interest).

[RMC-002] Reference Material Certificates MUST have at least one properties block with the attribute isCertified="true" containing certified property values (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.3 — Property value and associated uncertainty: 'Mandatory' for RM certificate). A certificate without certified values is structurally invalid.
[RMC-003] Reference Material Certificates MUST include property values (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.3 — Property value and associated uncertainty).

[RMC-005] Reference Material Certificates SHOULD document the measurement procedures used for certified properties (ISO 33401:2024, §5.4.2 — Measurement procedures for non-operationally defined measurands: 'Recommended' for both document profiles).

[PIS-001] Product Information Sheets MUST NOT mark any properties block as isCertified="true". Only Reference Material Certificate documents (CRM) may contain certified property values. Setting isCertified="true" on a productInformationSheet document constitutes a misrepresentation of the material's metrological status and violates the ISO 33401:2024 distinction between RMs and CRMs.
[PIS-002] Product Information Sheets MUST include results where property values are assigned (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.15 — Property of interest).

children.name: properties
children.description: A core analytical chapter block grouping characterization data. Encapsulates underlying instrumentation procedures, environmental parameters, and measurement tables. Controls metrological confidence extraction through an explicit @isCertified boolean attribute to ensure uncompromised data validation. PROFILE NOTE (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.3): - referenceMaterialCertificate: MUST contain at least one properties block with @isCertified="true". Certified property values MUST include measurement uncertainty and metrological traceability (Schematron rules RMC-002, RMC-003). - productInformationSheet: MUST NOT set @isCertified="true" on any properties block. Uncertainty values are optional (Schematron rule PIS-001).

Restricts the scope of relation attributes to ensure uniform machine interpretation of linked element semantics. - basic_certificateIdentification: Maps an operational identity token specifically to a document metadata anchor. - basic_measuredValue: Validates and assigns measurement payload segments explicitly as structured quantity records.

attributes.name: isCertified
attributes.description: A critical processing flag governing metrological automated ingestion policies. Must evaluate as 'true' to qualify content as fully certified data. When evaluated as 'false' or omitted, signaling processing systems that values are informational only. PROFILE NOTE (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.3): - referenceMaterialCertificate: At least one properties block MUST have isCertified="true", and all certified property values MUST include expanded measurement uncertainty and metrological traceability. - productInformationSheet: isCertified MUST NOT be set to "true" on any properties block. This prevents informational RM documents from being misrepresented as certified data.

rules.description: [RMC-002] Reference Material Certificates MUST have at least one properties block with the attribute isCertified="true" containing certified property values (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.3 — Property value and associated uncertainty: 'Mandatory' for RM certificate). A certificate without certified values is structurally invalid.

[RMC-005] Reference Material Certificates SHOULD document the measurement procedures used for certified properties (ISO 33401:2024, §5.4.2 — Measurement procedures for non-operationally defined measurands: 'Recommended' for both document profiles).

[PIS-001] Product Information Sheets MUST NOT mark any properties block as isCertified="true". Only Reference Material Certificate documents (CRM) may contain certified property values. Setting isCertified="true" on a productInformationSheet document constitutes a misrepresentation of the material's metrological status and violates the ISO 33401:2024 distinction between RMs and CRMs.

[PIS-003] In productInformationSheet documents, individual properties blocks MUST NOT have isCertified="true". This attribute should be omitted or set to "false" for all property blocks in a Product Information Sheet. Certified property values are only permitted in referenceMaterialCertificate documents.
[DRMD-003] Every DRMD document MUST contain at least one properties block with measurement data (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.15 — Property of interest).

[RMC-002] Reference Material Certificates MUST have at least one properties block with the attribute isCertified="true" containing certified property values (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.3 — Property value and associated uncertainty: 'Mandatory' for RM certificate). A certificate without certified values is structurally invalid.
[RMC-003] Reference Material Certificates MUST include property values (ISO 33401:2024, §5.3.3 — Property value and associated uncertainty).

[RMC-005] Reference Material Certificates SHOULD document the measurement procedures used for certified properties (ISO 33401:2024, §5.4.2 — Measurement procedures for non-operationally defined measurands: 'Recommended' for both document profiles).

[PIS-001] Product Information Sheets MUST NOT mark any properties block as isCertified="true". Only Reference Material Certificate documents (CRM) may contain certified property values. Setting isCertified="true" on a productInformationSheet document constitutes a misrepresentation of the material's metrological status and violates the ISO 33401:2024 distinction between RMs and CRMs.
[PIS-002] Product Information Sheets MUST include results where property values are assigned (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.15 — Property of interest).

children.name: procedures
children.description: Roster detailing laboratory methods, hardware systems, instrument integration times, and standard citations (e.g., ISO 11885) to establish absolute procedural replication visibility. NOTE: This element covers both applied measurement procedures (methods used to establish the property values) and intended measurement procedures (methods for which the material is suited). Producers are encouraged to clearly distinguish between these in the method descriptions. ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.14 makes procedures for operationally defined measurands 'mandatory whenever applicable'; §5.4.2 makes procedures for non-operationally defined measurands 'recommended' for both document profiles. Taken together, the overall requirement is 'mandatory whenever applicable'. The companion Schematron rule DRMD-014 (conditional-error) enforces the presence of procedures; RMC-005 (warning) provides an additional advisory for certified property blocks.

rules.description: [DRMD-014] Each properties block MUST include measurement procedures whenever applicable. This combines two ISO requirements: procedures for operationally defined measurands (ISO 33401:2024, §5.2.14 — 'Mandatory whenever applicable' for both document profiles) and procedures for non-operationally defined measurands (ISO 33401:2024, §5.4.2 — 'Recommended' for both document profiles). Taken together, the overall requirement is 'Mandatory whenever applicable'.

[RMC-005] Reference Material Certificates SHOULD document the measurement procedures used for certified properties (ISO 33401:2024, §5.4.2 — Measurement procedures for non-operationally defined measurands: 'Recommended' for both document profiles).

children.name: list
children.description: A sequential sequence indexing repeating quantity rows. Serves as the structural framework for compositional tables where every unique analyte row encapsulates individual D-SI unit records, uncertainty fields, and identity codes.

children.name: quantity
children.description: An enhanced metrological quantity container that extends the foundational dcc:primitiveQuantityType framework. Enables numeric measurement property fields, uncertainties, and D-SI units to directly encapsulate DRMD-specific property identifiers, providing strict machine-readability for multi-analyte dataset matrices.

children.name: real
children.description: Metadata element definition for a real measurement quantity. The following statements of a real quantity are possible. [(m)-mandatory, (o)-optional] 1. Basic measured quantity (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element value (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI format) (o) - element significantDigit (integer) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) 2. Measured quantity with univariate measurement uncertainty (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element value (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI format) (o) - element significantDigit (integer) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (m) - element measurementUncertaintyUnivariate (si:measurementUncertaintyUnivaraiteType) # with choice si:standardMU or si:expandedMU or si:coverageIntervalMU # or [deprecated] si:expandedUnc # or [deprecated] si:coverageInterval Integration into external XML: <myXML xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:si="https://ptb.de/si"> <xs:element name="individualElement"> <xs:complexType> <xs:sequence> <xs:element ref="si:real"/> </xs:sequence> </xs:complexType> </xs:element> </myXML>

children.name: label
children.description: A human-readable label string identifying the quantity or coordinate.

children.name: quantityType
children.description: Definition of placeholder element for providing different quantity types.

children.name: value
children.description: Scientific decimal format for numerical values. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: unit
children.description: BIPM SI brochure unit (9th edition). Based on xs:string.

children.name: significantDigit
children.description: Type providing information on the significat digit of si:value. This integer number represents the exponent of a power of 10 which identifies the ISO 80000 rounding range of the significant digit. .

children.name: dateTime
children.description: A date-time value in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-06-15T10:30:00Z").

children.name: measurementUncertaintyUnivariate
children.description: Univariate measurement uncertainty container with standard, expanded, and coverage interval options.

children.name: standardMU
children.description: Definition of standard measurement uncertainty data.

children.name: valueStandardMU
children.description: Scientific decimal format for numerical values of standard measurement uncertainty that must be positive (greater than zero or equal to zero). Based on type xs:double.

children.name: distribution
children.description: String providing a distribution (statistical distribution of measurement values).

children.name: expandedMU
children.description: Definition of expanded measurement uncertainty data.

children.name: valueExpandedMU
children.description: Scientific decimal format for numerical values of expanded measurement uncertainty that must be positive (greater than zero or equal to zero). Based on type xs:double.

children.name: coverageFactor
children.description: Scientific decimal format for coverage factor values for uncertainties that must be greater than one or equal to one. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: coverageProbability
children.description: Decimal format for coverage probability values for uncertainties. The value must be within the interval [0,1]. The scientific exponent "e" (or "E") is not allowed. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: distribution
children.description: String providing a distribution (statistical distribution of measurement values).

children.name: coverageIntervalMU
children.description: Definition of coverage interval measurement uncertainty data.

children.name: valueStandardMU
children.description: Scientific decimal format for numerical values of standard measurement uncertainty that must be positive (greater than zero or equal to zero). Based on type xs:double.

children.name: intervalMin
children.description: Scientific decimal format for numerical values. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: intervalMax
children.description: Scientific decimal format for numerical values. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: coverageProbability
children.description: Decimal format for coverage probability values for uncertainties. The value must be within the interval [0,1]. The scientific exponent "e" (or "E") is not allowed. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: distribution
children.description: String providing a distribution (statistical distribution of measurement values).

children.name: expandedUnc
children.description: [deprecated element] use si:expandedMU

children.name: uncertainty
children.description: [deprecated element] use si:valueExpandedMUType or si:valueStandardMUType

children.name: coverageFactor
children.description: Scientific decimal format for coverage factor values for uncertainties that must be greater than one or equal to one. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: coverageProbability
children.description: Decimal format for coverage probability values for uncertainties. The value must be within the interval [0,1]. The scientific exponent "e" (or "E") is not allowed. Based on type xs:double.

children.name: distribution
children.description: String providing the statistical distribution of measurement values (e.g., "normal", "rectangular").

children.name: coverageInterval

Basic measured quantity in Cartesian form with bivariate uncertainty (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element valueReal (decimal value type) (m) - element valueImag (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (m) - choice si:ellipsoidalRegion or si:rectangularRegion for the bivariate uncertainty 4. Basic measured quantity in polar form with bivariate uncertainty (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element valueMagnitude (decimal value type) (m) - element valuePhase (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (m) - element unitPhase (string - SI unit for an angular quantity) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (m) - choice si:ellipsoidalRegion or si:rectangularRegion for the bivariate uncertainty

children.name: constant
children.description: Definition of a structure for real numbers, that represent for fundamental physical constants and mathematical constants. The element has the following components [(m)-mandatory, (o)-optional]: (o) - element label (string) (o) - element quantityTypeQUDT (qudt:quantitykind Type) (m) - element value (decimal value type) (m) - element unit (string - SI unit) (o) - element significantDigit (integer) (o) - element dateTime (xs:dateTime) (o) - element valueStandardMU (decimal value >= 0) (o) - element distribution (string) The value and the uncertainty have the unit specified by the element unit. For fundamental physical constants, that are defined experimentally, the uncertainty is the standard deviation. For rounded mathematical constants, the uncertainty is the standard deviation of a rectangular distribution (element value defines center point), that contains the exact value of the constant with 100 percent probability.

children.name: Signature
children.description: An optional, repeatable XML Digital Signature (XMLDSig) block providing cryptographic proof of document integrity and origin. Enables independent validation that data has escaped post-issuance tampering. Note: Validation stubs permit flexible content schema modeling, meaning deep cryptographic checks must be enforced independently via runtime libraries.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the XML Digital Signature element.

children.name: SignedInfo
children.description: The signed information block containing the canonicalization method, signature algorithm, and references to the signed data. This element is itself signed to ensure integrity.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the XML Digital Signature element.

children.name: CanonicalizationMethod
children.description: Specifies the canonicalization algorithm applied to the SignedInfo element before signing (e.g., Exclusive XML Canonicalization).

attributes.name: Algorithm
attributes.description: URI identifying the algorithm used (e.g., canonicalization, signature, or digest algorithm).

children.name: SignatureMethod
children.description: Identifies the algorithm used for signature generation and validation (e.g., RSA-SHA256, ECDSA-SHA384).

attributes.name: Algorithm
attributes.description: URI identifying the algorithm used (e.g., canonicalization, signature, or digest algorithm).

children.name: HMACOutputLength
children.description: Optional element specifying the truncation length of an HMAC signature output in bits.

children.name: Reference
children.description: A reference to a specific data object to be signed, including optional transforms, the digest algorithm, and the computed digest value.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the XML Digital Signature element.

attributes.name: URI
attributes.description: URI reference identifying the data object to be signed or retrieved.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: URI identifying the type of the referenced data object.

children.name: Transforms
children.description: An ordered list of processing transforms applied to the referenced data object before digest computation.

children.name: Transform
children.description: A single processing step applied to referenced data (e.g., enveloped-signature transform, XPath filtering, or canonicalization).

attributes.name: Algorithm
attributes.description: URI identifying the algorithm used (e.g., canonicalization, signature, or digest algorithm).

children.name: XPath
children.description: An XPath expression used as a filter transform to select specific portions of the XML document for signing.

children.name: DigestMethod
children.description: Identifies the digest (hash) algorithm applied to the referenced data object (e.g., SHA-256, SHA-384).

attributes.name: Algorithm
attributes.description: URI identifying the algorithm used (e.g., canonicalization, signature, or digest algorithm).

children.name: DigestValue
children.description: The Base64-encoded digest (hash) value computed over the referenced and transformed data object.

children.name: SignatureValue
children.description: The Base64-encoded cryptographic signature value computed over the canonicalized SignedInfo element.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the XML Digital Signature element.

children.name: KeyInfo
children.description: Optional element providing information about the key used to validate the signature, such as key names, key values, X.509 certificates, or retrieval methods.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the XML Digital Signature element.

children.name: KeyName
children.description: A human-readable string name identifying the signing key (e.g., "BAM-RM-Signing-Key-2024").

children.name: KeyValue
children.description: Contains the actual public key value used for signature validation, either as DSA or RSA key parameters.

children.name: RSAKeyValue
children.description: Contains the RSA public key parameters: Modulus and Exponent.

children.name: Modulus
children.description: The RSA public key modulus value (Base64-encoded).

children.name: Exponent
children.description: The RSA public key exponent value (Base64-encoded).

children.name: RetrievalMethod
children.description: A URI-based mechanism for retrieving key information from an external source.

children.name: X509Data
children.description: Contains X.509 certificate data for the signing key, including certificates, issuer/serial pairs, subject key identifiers, and CRLs.

children.name: X509IssuerSerial
children.description: Pair of issuer distinguished name and serial number uniquely identifying an X.509 certificate.

children.name: X509IssuerName
children.description: The distinguished name of the X.509 certificate issuer.

children.name: X509SerialNumber
children.description: The serial number of the X.509 certificate.

children.name: X509SKI
children.description: The Subject Key Identifier (SKI) extension value from the X.509 certificate.

children.name: X509SubjectName
children.description: The subject distinguished name from the X.509 certificate.

children.name: X509Certificate
children.description: The Base64-encoded DER representation of the X.509 certificate.

children.name: X509CRL
children.description: The Base64-encoded Certificate Revocation List (CRL) for verifying certificate validity.
